messages.subject: Supply Agreement — revised draft (v3) following our call
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Thank you for a constructive call. As agreed, attached is our revised draft (v3) reflecting the landing zone: general liability cap at 125% of trailing 12-month charges with LDs counting towards it; a separate 200% sub-cap on the IP indemnity; the annual index-linked price review reinstated but capped at 4% per Contract Year; minimum-commitment shortfall held at 15%; and termination for convenience available after the second anniversary on six months' notice.

If your client is content, we'll move to execution versions.

Kind regards,
James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
